title: Progress Services
desc: Centralized progress math, ETA, reconciliation, and broadcasting.
lede: Progress is computed in one place and broadcast, so every screen shows the same numbers.
body:
At a glance
  • One source for progress math.
  • Rounded sensibly; broadcast on meaningful change.
  • ETA estimation and reconciliation as truth.

Centralized math

Progress is calculated centrally and rounded (broadcasting only on meaningful change) to avoid noisy, inconsistent updates across screens.

ETA & reconciliation

ETAs come from observed throughput; reconciliation is the source of truth. What actually exists as validated artifacts wins over optimistic in-memory state.
